plugins.name: Voice typing
plugins.description: Convert Persian speech to text offline.

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.attribution: Shenava Koochik v1.5 RNNT sherpa-onnx model; upstream revision c46e9af380770a07509a3591169c99e936e0cc96

plugins.release_notes: Experimental offline Persian RNNT model. Sherpa-ONNX nemo_transducer. Upstream revision c46e9af380770a07509a3591169c99e936e0cc96; author-reported Golden-6669 WER 9.50% / CER 2.60%. Not yet independently benchmarked on Link devices.

plugins.name: Magic Touch Photo
plugins.description: Draw a green Keep+ lasso to preserve its selected area, or a red Keep- lasso to remove its selected area.

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.attribution: MediaPipe Tasks Vision and MagicTouch model by Google

plugins.release_notes: Repackages the reviewed lasso-based Keep+ and Keep- runtime with its pinned MediaPipe native dependency set. Keep+ preserves the selected area; Keep- removes the selected area while preserving the rest.

plugins.name: Smart Translate
plugins.description: Detects source language and translates on-device with managed offline language models. Link asks before downloading missing models and lets users keep or remove downloaded languages.

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.attribution: Google ML Kit Translation and Language Identification APIs

plugins.release_notes: Uses the Google Play services consent UI to install the optional Language ID module, waits for confirmed availability, and keeps explicit download/keep/remove controls for translation language models; caches LanguageIdentifier and Translator clients to reduce repeated setup and translation latency.

plugins.name: Read text

license.name: MIT + GPL-3.0-or-later
license.attribution: Mana Persian Piper model (MIT) and eSpeak NG phoneme data (GPL-3.0-or-later)

plugins.release_notes: Migration package reconstructed from the currently published immutable Mana ZIP. Preserves its payload and license notices; upstream source archives and their cryptographic hashes still need to be pinned independently.
